summary: Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC filed an 8-K reporting the September 11, 2026 payoff and termination of its $500 million 2024 Revolving Credit Agreement with Wells Fargo as agent, alongside completion of an $800 million 5.65% senior secured notes offering due 2036 and a $1 billion 6.35% senior secured notes offering due 2066. Net proceeds of roughly $1.78 billion fund general corporate purposes and repay $625 million term loan, $480 million revolver, $375 million receivables facility and commercial paper. Routine refinancing, not a special situation; watch leverage and rate resets.
